# Harmon Andrews & Jane Andrews

- [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) — Saved — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) — caught her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard into the Lake of Shining Waters · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concocts a false confession in hopes of being allowed to go to the Sunday school picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) still forbids her from going. However, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) soon discovers the brooch snagged in her lace shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and sends her off to enjoy the picnic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P1](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to attend the Sunday school picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed by the day's excitement and ice cream, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later recounts the whole incident to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P67](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P69](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0069)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after rejecting [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), but learns from [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) that he recovers quickly from heartbreak. She hears [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde, clashes with Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) over Jane's lavish engagement, and attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her newborn baby, feeling increasingly lonely as her friends move on into new stages of life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings
